verdict.rationale: Runloop documents mechanisms consistent with least-privilege credential handling for agents: Agent Gateways let agents call LLM APIs 'without ever seeing your API keys' (runloop-docs-10), account-level Secrets are encrypted and injected as env vars rather than exposed directly (runloop-docs-21/42), MCP Hub gives agents access to tool servers 'without exposing credentials' (runloop-docs-66), and network policies let you control egress (runloop-docs-58). However, there's no explicit documentation of issuing scoped/permission-limited Runloop platform API keys (e.g., role-based or read-only API tokens) for agents themselves. Missing for 10: explicit scoped API-key/token issuance with configurable permission levels for Runloop's own API, and independent confirmation of least-privilege enforcement.
